description: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has been launched in select global markets, as the latest competitor to the iPhone 18 Pro Max and Oppo Find X10 Pro Max. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is identical to its Chinese counterpart in terms of design. It has a horizontal rear camera module, similar to its predecessor. Meanwhile, the iPhone 18 Pro Max also gets a rectangular horizontal rear camera island. The phone sports a smaller Dynamic Island feature and a repositioned Face ID sensor. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is equipped with Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. The mobile platform is built on a 2nm process and delivers a peak clock speed of up to 5.01GHz.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max vs iPhone 18 Pro Max vs Oppo Find X10 Pro Max: Price and Specifications Compared

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro launched recently with dual 200-megapixel cameras, a secondary rear display, and 100W wired charging. Here's a comparison of the Xiaomi 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro, and Google Pixel 11 Pro based on their specifications and features.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro vs iPhone 18 Pro vs Google Pixel 11 Pro: Price, Specifications Compared

description: Lumio Aura 5, recently launched in India, marked the Indian tech firm's entry into a new space, namely home audio. The bookshelf speakers aim to replace conventional soundbars kept under your smart TVs. With a 100W RMS output, the Lumio Aura 5 punches above its weight. The speakers offer many connectivity options, which is a major plus. However, its balanced sound profile and room-filling loudness make it a great piece of tech for audiophiles. The competitive pricing makes the Lumio Aura 5 an easy home audio solution to recommend.
title: Lumio Aura 5 Review: Skip the Soundbar, Buy These Speakers

description: India’s clip-on earbud options range from premium models with advanced sound features to affordable pairs focused on battery life and everyday use. Sony’s LinkBuds Clip support 360 Reality Audio, while Realme adds spatial audio and an AI Translator. Motorola’s Moto Buds Loop feature Bose-tuned drivers, and Noise’s Air Clips V2 promise up to 40 hours of playback. Boat’s Airdopes ProClip offer the longest claimed battery life in this selection, at 52 hours, and are the most affordable at Rs. 1,799.
title: Best Clip-On Earbuds to Buy in India Across Different Price Segments

description: Wi-Fi Calling is a useful feature when mobile network coverage is weak indoors, particularly in homes, offices and buildings where cellular signals struggle to reach. The feature allows users to make and receive regular phone calls using an available Wi-Fi connection instead of relying entirely on a nearby mobile tower. It is supported by several smartphones and Indian telecom operators, including Airtel and Reliance Jio.
title: How to Enable Wi-Fi Calling on iPhone and Android in India: A Step-by-Step Guide
